Here's a concise implementation plan for finding the largest prime factor:

• Divide `n` by 2 repeatedly while it's even, tracking 2 as a potential largest prime factor, then proceed with odd divisors starting from 3

• Iterate through odd numbers from 3 up to √n, dividing `n` by each divisor as many times as possible when it divides evenly, updating the largest prime factor found

• After the loop, if the remaining value of `n` is greater than 1, it represents a prime factor larger than √(original n), so return it as the largest prime factor; otherwise return the last tracked prime factor
